verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API for programmatic access to the platform, covering management of organizations, teams and data export, with region-specific domains. It also publishes an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema for the full /api/0/ surface and an API deprecation policy. The 404s at the docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the schema is published in the getsentry/sentry-api-schema repo. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Sentry via the API, a stable versioned API (v0 is described as still under development and beta endpoints are subject to change).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically. You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
The official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API"
Our public endpoints are generally stable, but beta endpoints are subject to change.
